info.title: Cairn
info.description:
Cairn is a knowledge base platform and RAG infrastructure server.

Agents are clients: point at this URL, present an API key, send a query and a
knowledge base ID, and receive ranked, cited passages.

**Phase 0** ships authentication only. Knowledge base, ingestion, and retrieval
endpoints arrive in Phase 2.

get.description:
Unauthenticated. Lets a client discover what this deployment supports
rather than finding out via a 404.

post.summary: Authenticate with a username and password
post.description:
Returns `status: "ok"` and sets a session cookie on success.

When the account must change its credentials first, returns `status: "password_change_required"` with a short-lived, scope-limited `change_token` and **no session cookie**. That token is accepted only by `POST /v1/auth/complete-initial-setup`; every other endpoint responds `403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED` until the change is completed.

Requires the `change_token` from login as a bearer token. Updates the password and, optionally, the username in a single transaction; if the username is taken the whole operation rolls back and the password is unchanged. On success every existing session is revoked and a new session cookie is issued.

get.description: Allowlisted during a mandatory credential change so the UI can render the dialog for the correct account.

schema.title: Response List Users V1 Users Get

post.description: The new account starts with a mandatory credential change, so the generated password is a one-time handover rather than a shared secret.

delete.description: Soft delete. Revokes every session, grant, and API key the account held — a key that outlives its owner is a credential nobody is accountable for.

post.summary: Require a credential change at next login
post.description: Reuses the identical forced flow as first-boot bootstrap (FR-A-12).
Administrators may grant anything. Other principals may only delegate permissions they hold themselves, on resources they manage.

schema.title: Response List User Grants V1 Users  User Id  Grants Get

get.description: The union of a subject's live grants, plus any role-implied capabilities. This is what the system actually evaluates.

post.summary: Open time-boxed administrator access to knowledge base content
post.description: Under the default `break_glass` policy an administrator manages a knowledge base but cannot read its content. This opens a time-boxed, reasoned, audited window. The owner is notified.
The key's effective permissions are the intersection of the requested scopes with the owner's own permissions, recomputed at every request. The plaintext key is returned once and is not recoverable.

schema.title: Response List Api Keys V1 Api Keys Get

delete.description: Takes effect immediately across every replica, not after the cache TTL.

get.description: What can be granted, by resource type. Drives the admin UI.

schema.title: Response Permission Catalogue V1 Workspace Permissions Get
Response Rate Limit State V1 Me Rate Limit Get

get.description: Append-only. Filterable by actor, action, resource, outcome, and time range.

schema.title: Response Query Audit Log V1 Audit Log Get

get.summary: Export the audit log as JSONL
get.description: Streamed in batches. An export covering a year must not materialise in the API process.
`oldest_ready_age_seconds` is the signal that matters: depth alone can look healthy while one task sits behind a saturated workspace.

schema.title: Response Queue Stats V1 Tasks Queues Get

post.description: The embedding model is validated here, before anything is written. It becomes immutable once the knowledge base has been indexed (ADR-0006).

get.description: Administrators see the whole workspace; everyone else sees only the knowledge bases they hold a grant on. The filter is applied in the query, so inaccessible rows are never fetched.

patch.description: Changing the embedding model or metric on an indexed knowledge base is refused with a pointer to the reindex endpoint, because mixing embedding spaces in one index degrades retrieval silently.

delete.description: Accepted, not completed: the row is marked and a purge task removes the documents, chunks, vectors, and objects in the background.

post.description: Without `confirm` this returns a cost estimate and starts nothing. With it, a new index version begins building while the active one keeps serving queries (ADR-0007).

schema.title: Response Start Reindex V1 Knowledge Bases  Kb Id  Reindex Post

get.description: Newest first. A failed build keeps its error so it stays diagnosable.

schema.title: Response List Index Versions V1 Knowledge Bases  Kb Id  Index Versions Get

post.description: Registers content already written to object storage and queues it for parsing. The bytes never pass through this endpoint, so a large upload does not occupy an API worker. Content already present in this knowledge base comes back as `skipped`, which is a success.

schema.title: Response Register Documents V1 Knowledge Bases  Kb Id  Documents Post

post.description: Resumes the durable failed stage for a document in `failed`.

get.description: Defaults to the active index version. Paginated by `after_ordinal` rather than a cursor, because chunk order within a document is stable and meaningful.

schema.title: Response List Chunks V1 Knowledge Bases  Kb Id  Documents  Document Id  Chunks Get

patch.description: Marks the chunk as edited so the next rebuild carries the correction forward (FR-F-09). Only chunks in the active index version are editable — an edit to a building version would be discarded by the next switch, which looks like data loss.

post.description: Reachability is verified before this returns, so a misconfigured backend fails here rather than when the first document is uploaded.

get.description: Guarded by `kb:create` rather than `platform:storage`: choosing a backend is part of creating a knowledge base, and the response carries no credentials.

schema.title: Response List Bindings V1 Storage Bindings Get
Response Test Binding V1 Storage Bindings  Binding Id  Test Post

delete.description: Refused while any knowledge base still points at it.

schema.title: Response List Providers V1 Model Providers Get
Response List Models V1 Models Get

post.summary: Retrieve cited chunks from knowledge bases
post.description: Requires kb:query on every target. Supports bounded full-text (BM25), vector, and hybrid search; unsupported advanced options are rejected or reported degraded.

warning.title: Warning
warning.default: This key is displayed once and cannot be retrieved again.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this access is needed. Recorded in the audit log and sent to the knowledge base owner.

warning.title: Warning
warning.default: This password is displayed once and cannot be retrieved again.

DocumentRegistrationResponse.title: DocumentRegistrationResponse
DocumentRegistrationResponse.description:
One entry in a bulk registration result.

``skipped`` is not a failure: re-registering identical content is the normal
outcome of a retried sync, and reporting it as an error trains users to
ignore errors.

DocumentStateCounts.title: DocumentStateCounts
DocumentStateCounts.description: Counts by pipeline state — what the ingestion progress bar is built from.

EffectivePermissionsResponse.title: EffectivePermissionsResponse
EffectivePermissionsResponse.description:
Answers "why can this principal do that?" — the question an operator
actually asks during a review.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
Two shapes in one model, discriminated by ``status``.

On ``password_change_required`` there is **no session cookie** on the
response and no session token here — see FR-A-04.

RegisterUploadRequest.title: RegisterUploadRequest
RegisterUploadRequest.description:
Registers content already written to object storage.

The bytes do not pass through this endpoint: the client uploads to a
presigned URL and then registers the result, so a 500 MB PDF never occupies
an API worker.

ReindexEstimateResponse.title: ReindexEstimateResponse
ReindexEstimateResponse.description:
Returned when ``confirm`` is absent. Nothing has been started.

Spending hours of compute and provider budget on a UI click nobody costed is
a footgun, so the cost is shown before the rebuild rather than after.

embedding_model_id.title: Embedding Model Id
embedding_model_id.description: The only supported way to change the embedding model.

UpdateKbRequest.title: UpdateKbRequest
UpdateKbRequest.description:
A partial update: every field is optional and ``None`` means "unchanged".

``embedding_model_id`` and ``metric`` are accepted rather than rejected by
the schema so the service can answer with the reindex path (ADR-0006);
silently dropping them would leave the caller believing a change landed.
